description: This file defines a React functional component named Sidebar that renders a sidebar with a list of folders/tags for organizing notes. It includes UI elements like a header, an 'Add Folder' button, and a list of folder items that can be selected.

methods.name: Sidebar({ folders, activeFolder, onSelectFolder, onAddFolder })
methods.description: React functional component that displays a sidebar with folders and an 'Add Folder' button. It accepts props for folder data, the active folder, and callback functions for selecting and adding folders.
